messages:
Maria Chavez: Heads up — new CVE (CVE-2026-XXXX) in crypto-parse v2.1.4. Public PoC on GH, vendor rates CVSS 9.1. We pull this in via kms-client.
Aj Patel: Link? severity?
Maria Chavez: https://github.com/[redacted]/poc — vendor advisory says RCE in cert parsing. Affects 2.1.x and older 1.9.x backport branch. We use it in kms-client for hosted and private deploys.
Vinh Tran: Any signs it's being exploited against us yet?
Maria Chavez: No telemetry hits so far, but public PoC exists. Recommend treat as HIGH (public exposure).
Elaine Kim: Impact overview: hosted customers on default images will be vulnerable. Dedicated customers may be on pinned images — need to check image versions. Private customers often run their own stacks; if they're using Redwood's kms-client package, they're at risk.
Aj Patel: Proposed plan: 1) Emergency patch + canary for hosted tonight (22:00 UTC). 2) Notify Dedicated customers with affected versions and offer patch windows. 3) Contact Private customers individually and offer assisted backport + deploy help. Agree?
Vinh Tran: Can do hosted per-region canary at 22:00 UTC -> full rollout target 02:00 UTC. We'll do rolling restarts of inference pods with the new image. Expect brief 5-7s latency spikes per pod during restart; should stay within 99.9% SLO but note as maintenance.
Elaine Kim: We need comms that call out maintenance window and SLA implications (possible credits). Support Oncall, can you draft the customer notice and escalation templates?
Support Oncall: Yep — I will draft the notice and escalation matrix. Please provide list of affected Dedicated customers by 09:00 PT tomorrow.
Maria Chavez: Temporary mitigation: kms-client has a flag `--no-auto-parse` to skip cert parsing; it reduces attack surface but will break some integrations that rely on embedded cert parsing. Not ideal as a long-term fix.
Aj Patel: Who will own the release, runbook, and rollback plan?
Vinh Tran: I'll own the build, canary run, and post-deploy checks. Maria — you own the CVE advisory and customer-facing notes. Elaine will coordinate customer outreach. Aj will own rollback plan and SOC coordination.
Maria Chavez: Patch targets: hosted canary tonight, full hosted rollout by 02:00 UTC; Dedicated urgent windows this week (offer next-available slot); Private customers to be scheduled within 48 hours and offered backport. Backport task for 1.9.x assigned to eng-security-backports.
Support Oncall: Noted. I'll prepare the incident channel, triage checklist, and support templates.
Elaine Kim: Also loop in Legal for disclosure timeline if exploit appears in the wild.
Aj Patel: Monitoring/checks to add: alert on kms-client crash loops, >3% increase in 5xx from auth service, and IAM token errors. Add a temporary anomaly alert on unusual cert parsing logs.
Vinh Tran: Added alerts to the staging config; will push to prod after canary. I'll post the alert rule snippets in #eng-runtime once live.
Maria Chavez: Filing incident ticket now and assigning postmortem leads. Thanks all — moving to action. :thumbsup:
